normal.notes:
Your Mac stays signed in. This Mac could sign itself out after an update, and once it did it quietly stopped being reachable from your iPhone until you signed in again. The cause was a saved sign-in that could never be overwritten, so an old one kept coming back and getting rejected. Fixed — and it now survives updates.

Sound uses about 21x less data. The Mac's audio was sent uncompressed: roughly 675 MB an hour, spent whether or not anything was actually playing. It is now around 30 MB an hour at the same quality.

Connecting on the same Wi-Fi works. Choosing “Same network” never completed — this Mac accepted the connection and then never answered it. Fixed.

Also: the picture appears much faster when you reconnect, you can paste text from your iPhone straight onto this Mac, and quitting Overhand in the middle of a drag no longer leaves your mouse button stuck down.

beta.notes:
Session persistence: KeychainStore.set discarded both SecItem status codes, so on a re-signed binary the delete was denied, the add returned errSecDuplicateItem, and the write silently did nothing — leaving a months-old token that load() preferred over the good file mirror, mirrored back over it, and then had cleared by the 401 handler. Writes now fall back to SecItemUpdate, and macOS prefers the durable file, which cannot silently fail to be written.

Audio is negotiated AAC-LC at 96 kbps (measured ~32 MB/hour vs 675 MB/hour of Int16 PCM). The capability byte is appended to setAudioActive so an older host ignores it and an older viewer claims nothing — both stay on PCM. Codec + magic cookie are announced on the reliable channel; the codec rides in every packet.

Same-network connect: an accepted LANConnection had zero strong owners and was deallocated before .ready could fire, so peerConnected never ran and no auth challenge was ever sent. The host now holds accepted connections until pendingTransport takes over.

Also: keyframe-aware backpressure (the black screen on reconnect), clipboard push (wire tag 14), the session audio toggle, sharing lifetime moved off the view tree, and NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription.
